integrity: Analytical finite-dimensional proof. A 326-check reproducibility script corroborates the formula; no independent assessment is represented.
scientific_limitations: One-particle, uniform site dephasing, equal star hoppings, single absorbing hub; mean infinite at zero dephasing unless the input is exactly bright; no finite-time quantile or spectral-gap optimality is asserted.
title: Coherence-dependent optimal dephasing for lossy star quantum walks
